input.question: What year did the Battle of Taku Forts take place?

documents.text: that Canton had been occupied on 27 January 1858 . The British commander Michael Seymour , hoping to force a settlement ( the later Treaty of Tianjin ) , ordered an attack on the Taku Forts as they were the closer path towards Peking . The fortresses were then looted , where the British and French found many weapons and cannons , both foreign and domestically cast .
